title: 7 Things a Man Does While God Prepares His Wife
caption:
Waiting doesn't have to look like checking her Instagram every night.

Pray for the man to be built, not just the woman to be sent. Stop auditioning in every room that has a woman in it. Get your own life running before you ask her into it. Treat the women around you now like sisters, not options.

Build a week you wouldn't be ashamed to hand her. Stay close to men, not just apps. And trust a timeline you can't see yet, delight yourself in the Lord first (Psalm 37:4). The order was never optional.

How you wait says more than how you'll propose.

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
